def owner_key_of(self, artifact_id: str) -> str | None:
        """Owner key of an artifact, or None when the artifact is unknown."""
        meta = self.get_meta(artifact_id)
        return meta.owner_key if meta is not None else None
claim: ArtifactStore.owner_key_of has no caller in production code and appears to be an obsolete duplicate access helper.
trigger: Any deployed request through the application, including all artifact-management and read routes, because no src/*.py path invokes this method; only tests/test_store.py calls it.
impact: The method is shipped but never participates in application behavior, increasing maintenance/API surface without serving a product flow.

evidence.detail: Searched all application sources with rg -n 'owner_key_of\(' src tests README.md docs skills -g '!_review/**'; matches are the definition in src/store.py and three tests in tests/test_store.py.
The method only delegates to get_meta() and returns owner metadata; route authorization paths use meta.owner_key directly or _owner_only instead (src/main.py).

suggested_fix: Remove the unused method or document and invoke it through an intentional service/library contract.
